```artifact
Feature: System Backup and Reporting

  Scenario: System Backup
    Given the system is running
    When the backup process is triggered
    Then the system backup is successful
    And the backup is sent to the remote site
    And the backup is rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: User Authentication
    Given a user is registered with a username and password
    When the user logs in with their credentials
    Then the user is authenticated successfully

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given a patient is not registered
    When the patient registers with a username and password
    Then the patient is registered successfully
    And the patient can log in with their credentials

  Scenario: Doctor Wise Appointment Report
    Given the system has appointments for the next 5 days
    When the doctor wise appointment report is generated
    Then the report shows the appointments for the next 5 days

  Scenario: Speciality Wise Consultation Report
    Given the system has consultations for the month
    When the speciality wise consultation report is generated
    Then the report shows the number of consultations per month

  Scenario: Speciality Wise Revenue Report
    Given the system has revenue data for the month
    When the speciality wise revenue report is generated
    Then the report shows the revenue earned per month

  Scenario Outline: System Backup with Different Rotation Periods
    Given the system is running
    When the backup process is triggered with rotation period <rotation_period>
    Then the system backup is successful
    And the backup is sent to the remote site
    And the backup is rotated every <rotation_period> days

    Examples:
      | rotation_period |
      | 15              |
      | 30              |
      | 45              |

  Scenario Outline: User Authentication with Different Credentials
    Given a user is registered with a username and password
    When the user logs in with username <username> and password <password>
    Then the user is authenticated successfully

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | valid    | valid    |
      | invalid  | valid    |
      | valid    | invalid  |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration with Different Credentials
    Given a patient is not registered
    When the patient registers with username <username> and password <password>
    Then the patient is registered successfully
    And the patient can log in with their credentials

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | valid    | valid    |
      | invalid  | valid    |
      | valid    | invalid  |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor Wise Appointment Report with Different Dates
    Given the system has appointments for the next 5 days
    When the doctor wise appointment report is generated for date <date>
    Then the report shows the appointments for the next 5 days

    Examples:
      | date       |
      | today      |
      | yesterday  |
      | tomorrow   |

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Wise Consultation Report with Different Time Periods
    Given the system has consultations for the month
    When the speciality wise consultation report is generated for time period <time_period>
    Then the report shows the number of consultations per month

    Examples:
      | time_period |
      | month       |
      | quarter     |
      | year        |

  Scenario Outline: Speciality Wise Revenue Report with Different Time Periods
    Given the system has revenue data for the month
    When the speciality wise revenue report is generated for time period <time_period>
    Then the report shows the revenue earned per month

    Examples:
      | time_period |
      | month       |
      | quarter     |
      | year        |
```
